testcase.name: Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 1: Verify that Title, Due Date, Staff, Task Status, and Task Type are mandatory fields in the "Create New Task" popup
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 2: Verify that a dropdown list opens when clicking on Task Type field in the "New Task" form
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 3: Verify that a dropdown list opens when clicking on Task Status field.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 4: Verify that selecting "Lead Management" from Task Type triggers the Lead Name dropdown in the task form
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 5: Verify that a task is created for the selected listing when lead name is selected from the dropdown.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 6: Verify that selecting a module shows a relevant dropdown list for that module (e.g., Listings, Properties, Projects)
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 7: Verify that selecting a listing from the dropdown creates a task linked to that listing
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 8: Verify that selecting the Property module shows a dropdown list for selecting a property
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 9: Verify that selecting a property from the dropdown creates a task linked to that property
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 10: Verify that selecting the "Project" module shows a dropdown list for selecting a project
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 11: Verify that selecting a project from the dropdown creates a task linked to that project
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 12: Verify that setting a reminder time sends an email or notification at the selected interval
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 13: Verify that recurring task checkbox shows a dropdown with "Weekly," "Monthly," and "Yearly" options.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 14: Verify that selecting "Weekly" from the recurring task dropdown sends email/notifications weekly.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 15: Verify that selecting "Monthly" from the recurring task dropdown sends email/notifications monthly.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 16: Verify that selecting "Yearly" from the recurring task dropdown sends email/notifications yearly.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 17: Verify that clicking "Sync Calendar" allows selection of a time period for task reminders
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 18: Verify that when a comment is added in the "Additional Comments" section, a notification is sent to the selected staff member.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 19: Verify that the added comment appears below the "Additional Comments" section once the task is saved.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 20: Verify that after adding a file and saving the task, the file appears only once even if "Save" is clicked twice
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 21: Verify that the added file appears correctly after saving the task.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 22: Verify that after creating a task, the "Create Sub Task" option becomes visible.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 23: Verify that clicking on the "Create Sub Task" button shows a field below the staff section to enter a sub task title.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 24: Verify that the sub task is visible within the parent task after creation.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 25: Verify that when the sub task is opened, a parent task dropdown is shown next to the team field.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 26: Verify that all fields of the original task are copied correctly to the new task when the "Copy Task" option is used.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 27: Verify that selecting a different parent task from the parent task dropdown updates the sub task’s parent task.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 28: Verify that the task is visible in the task list after it is saved.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 29: Verify that changes to the original task do not affect the copied task after it has been created.
